# Friendly Tech Concierge

Friendly Tech Concierge provides straightforward personal technology assistance in the Las Vegas area on a limited, appointment-based basis. Requests are reviewed individually for location, availability, and scope.

Website: https://friendlytechlv.com/
Phone: (702) 570-9003
Email: help@friendlytechlv.com

## Primary pages

- Home: https://friendlytechlv.com/
- Services: https://friendlytechlv.com/pricing.html
- About: https://friendlytechlv.com/about.html
- Request Help: https://friendlytechlv.com/request-help.html

## Current assistance categories

- Basic new-device setup
- Everyday consumer technology help
- Plain-language technology guidance
- Basic home-device connection where no electrical, structural, licensed, security-system, or specialized installation is required

Availability and service scope are determined only after a request is reviewed. Submission of a request does not create an appointment or guarantee service.

## Not provided

- Electrical or structured-cabling work
- Alarm, surveillance, or security-camera installation
- Commercial networking, servers, managed IT, or business cybersecurity
- Guaranteed account or data recovery
- Specialized hardware repair, soldering, or board-level repair
- Work requiring contractor licensing, permits, or specialized certification
- Emergency or around-the-clock support

## Guide archive

Previously published plain-language guides remain available at https://friendlytechlv.com/free-tech-help.html. They are general educational information and do not expand the current service offering.
